components.name: Button
components.description: Action button. Variant × Size × State × Icon only = 1,320 variants. Sizes M · L · XL · 2XL · 3XL (28 / 36 / 44 / 52 / 60 px), default M. Start icon / End icon are exposed nested _Icon instances (any BEK - Icons style). Icons and spinner always use the text colour. Selected = toggle (accent/soft for neutral, own solid colour for coloured variants). Disabled = fill/soft + text/disabled. Pressed live

codeSyntax yo'q (Figma Variables). Kodda Outline-danger hover = status/danger/soft + fill/soft overlay (doc 'Background — coloured Outline').

Raised hover foni — Figma doc Design tokens jadvalida 'Raised: fill/primary → fill/secondary' deb yozilgan, lekin komponent set'dagi Raised Hover varianti bu tokenga bog'lanmagan. Figma'da Raised/Hover variantini fill/secondary ga bog'lash kerak.
Raised bosilgan (:active) holati — doc'da 'Pressed (code)' deb belgilangan, Figma'da Pressed varianti yo'q; fill/primary → secondary → tertiary zinasi davom ettirilgan.

Flat-secondary variantining matn rangi — nomi text/secondary ni nazarda tutadi; Figma'da bu variant text/primary bilan chizilgan ko'rinadi. Figma'da Flat-secondary matnini text/secondary ga bog'lash kerak.

Normal/Outline/Flat-contrast fonlari — doc 'Contrast family keeps fill/on-color' deydi, komponent set'da bu tokenlar yo'q (ehtimol opacity bilan chizilgan). Figma'da contrast variantlarini fill/on-color (+hover/pressed) ga bog'lash kerak.
Contrast oilasi hover holati — fill/on-color-hover (doc: 'Contrast family keeps fill/on-color'); Figma variantlarida token bog'lanmagan.
Contrast oilasi pressed/selected holati — fill/on-color-pressed; Figma'da Pressed varianti yo'q (doc: 'Pressed (code)').
